STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_10201_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_10201_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_10201( 
                input clock,
				input reset,
				input enable,              
				input start,               
				input  signed [31:0] x,    
				input  signed [31:0] y,    
				output signed [31:0] mod,  
				output signed [31:0] angle 
			  );
			  

reg signed [33:0]	yr;
reg signed [33:0]	xr;
reg signed [31:0]	zr;
wire signed [31:0]	ATAN_data;
reg signed [5:0]  count_out;

always @(posedge clock or posedge reset)
begin
	if (reset)
		count_out <= 0;
	else if (enable)
		if (start)
			count_out <= 0;
		else if (count_out == 6'b111111)
			count_out <= count_out;
		else
			count_out <= count_out + 1;
end

always @(posedge clock)
begin	
	if(reset)
		xr <= 0;
	else if (enable)
		xr <= start ? x : (yr[33] ? xr - (yr >>> count_out) : xr + (yr >>> count_out));
end

always @(posedge clock)
begin
	if(reset)
		yr <= 0;
	else if (enable)	
		yr <= start ? y : (yr[33] ? yr + (xr >>> count_out) : yr - (xr >>> count_out));
end

always @(posedge clock)
begin
	if(reset)
		zr <= 0;
	else if (enable)
		zr <= start ? 32'b0 : (yr[33] ? zr - (ATAN_data) : zr + (ATAN_data));
end

reg signed [31:0] ATAN_ROM [0:47];

initial begin
	$readmemh("ATAN_ROM_VALUES.mem", ATAN_ROM);
end

assign ATAN_data = ATAN_ROM[count_out];

assign mod = (xr * xr + yr * yr);
assign angle = zr; 

endmodule
